# FU*K UR NEIGHBOR (F.U.N.)

> The cutthroat, standalone 4-player trick-taking mobile card game and Solitaire speed race.
> Produced and developed by TehWiz Productions (https://tehwiz.com).

## Overview

"FU*K UR NEIGHBOR" (F.U.N.) is a 100% standalone, client-side Single Page Application (SPA) card game designed for high-stakes competition, aggressive trick-taking, and frantic hand-shedding. Built without external servers or databases, F.U.N. runs entirely in the browser using Web Workers, local storage engines (IndexedDB / localStorage), Web Audio synthesis, and offline-ready PWA service workers.

- **Publisher / Studio**: TehWiz Productions
- **Official Website**: [https://tehwiz.com](https://tehwiz.com)
- **Source Code Repository**: [https://github.com/hoytnix/FUN-R3](https://github.com/hoytnix/FUN-R3)
- **Playable URL**: [https://hoytnix.github.io/FUN-R3/](https://hoytnix.github.io/FUN-R3/)

---

## The 4 Rounds of F.U.N.

Every match consists of exactly 4 rounds played by 4 players with a standard 52-card deck (13 cards dealt per player). **The objective is to finish the 4 rounds with the LOWEST cumulative point score.**

### Round 1: Hearts ♥
- **Trick-Taking Rule**: Standard trick-taking with Hearts as permanent Trump.
- **Penalty Rule**: Every Heart card captured in a trick awards **+10 penalty points** to the trick winner.
- **Strategy**: Force your opponents to take tricks containing Hearts while keeping your own trick count clean.

### Round 2: Royal Suite 👑
- **Trick-Taking Rule**: Hearts remain Trump.
- **Penalty Rule**: Capturing any King or Queen of ANY suit awards **+25 penalty points** per royalty card.
- **Strategy**: Dump high face cards on tricks you cannot avoid winning, or bait your neighbors into taking Royal cards.

### Round 3: Queen Sudden Death 💀
- **Trick-Taking Rule**: Hearts remain Trump.
- **Penalty Rule**: The Queen of Hearts carries a catastrophic **+100 penalty points**.
- **Strategy**: Track the Queen of Hearts religiously. If you hold it, discard it safely on an off-suit trick led by another player.

### Round 4: Solitaire Race 🏎️
- **Rule Paradigm Shift**: Round 4 transforms from trick-taking into a fast-paced hand-shedding card race.
- **Board Setup**: All 7s are placed onto the board foundation piles across the four suits (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades).
- **Play Mechanics**: Players take turns playing one legal card building upward from 7 to King (8, 9, 10, J, Q, K) or downward from 7 to Ace/2 (6, 5, 4, 3, 2, Ace).
- **Passing**: If a player has no legal moves, they are forced to pass.
- **Placements & Scoring**:
  - 1st to empty hand: **0 points** (Winner)
  - 2nd to empty hand: **+10 points**
  - 3rd to empty hand: **+25 points**
  - 4th (last with cards remaining): **+50 points**

---

## Game Modes

1. **Single Player vs. AI Bots**
   - Play immediately against 3 automated AI bots.
   - Three distinct AI difficulty settings:
     - *Easy*: Casual card choices with minimal memory tracking.
     - *Medium*: Follows standard suit discipline and avoids obvious penalties.
     - *Hard*: Advanced heuristic card-counting memory array, tracking played trumps, high royalty cards, and maximizing opponent bleed.
2. **Local Pass & Play**
   - 4 human players on a single shared screen or tablet.
   - Protected by `PassShield`—a physical turn-passing privacy overlay that hides hands between turns and prevents shoulder-surfing.
3. **Interactive Guided Tutorial**
   - 4-step action-locked interactive sandbox walkthrough explaining lead-suit discipline, penalty scoring, and Solitaire board building.

---

## Technical Architecture & Client Capabilities

- **100% Standalone Client-Side SPA**: Zero remote databases or backend APIs. No server dependencies, zero downtime.
- **Web Audio API Synthesizer**: Pure programmatic procedural sound synthesis for crisp card snaps, trick sweeps, victory fanfares, and buzzers without external audio asset downloads.
- **Offline Voice Commentary & Taunts**: Web SpeechSynthesis engine driving an animated, reactive play-by-play commentator (`pitch: 0.9`, `rate: 1.0`) and hilarious contextual bot taunts (`pitch: 1.3`, `rate: 1.2`).
- **Deterministic Replay System**: Full step-by-step game recorder computing 32-bit FNV-1a cryptographic state checksums per trick, viewable in an interactive replay modal with all 4 hands face-up.
- **PWA Ready**: Offline caching service worker with Network-First HTML fallback and Stale-While-Revalidate static asset caching.
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion.
